## Follow-up Comments
Refit leaves vLLM-Ascend 0.18 MXFP8 weights in the transformed layout.
`225-243`: ** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Heavy lift** **Refit leaves vLLM-Ascend 0.18 MXFP8 weights in the transformed layout.** The trainer exporter emits each MXFP8 weight and its scale in the pre-transform layout. The vLLM-Ascend 0.18 linear and MoE schemes transform loaded weights after loading. The refit hooks run only on modules that carry `_mxfp8_transformed` or `_mxfp8_original_shapes`. vLLM-Ascend 0.18 sets neither marker and has no `restore_weights_for_rl_loading`. Both hooks therefore skip these modules. Each refit bucket then loads trainer-layout tensors into parameters that already hold the transformed layout. The loader can raise a shape error. When the dimensions match, it can place transposed data without an error. The linear and MoE paths share this root cause. The correction must cover both paths in one boundary. Before the first bucket, undo the v0.18 transform for linear and MoE modules. After the last bucket, call the native v0.18 processing method. Each inverse must match the exact reshape and transpose of its scheme. The marker-based path does not apply to v0.18 and must remain for newer versions.
